notes:
- The `"hook"` patience is gone. `Patience` is now `"short" | "long" | Deadline`. `within(HOOK_WAIT_MS)` (5s) is made once in the agent-launch hook and passed to `resolveState` and `updateState`.

- The worst case is now about 5s plus one 25ms poll, down from about 9s. Git work and the commit while the lock is held are not bounded by the deadline.
- Patience defaults now live in `STATE_PATIENCE` ("short") and `WORKTREE_PATIENCE` ("long") in lock.ts. `editExclude`, `ensureWorktree`, `migrateWorkTree`, `updateState`, `withFileLock`, `withStateLock` and `setStateMode` read them.

- The real-hook test passes on base for the kill boundary, since base also exited before 10s. It failed on base only on its lower bound: the hook gave up at about 3s instead of waiting out the deadline.
- The shared-deadline unit test is the main proof that the waits add up to the deadline. Its red came from a per-lock mutant, not from base.
- The real-hook kill test spawns with `Bun.spawn` and its `timeout`, because the Bun Shell cannot kill on a timeout.
- The existing hooks.test.ts bound of `< 8000` on a held state lock could be tightened. I left it.
